finding: An assigned request with a finished source invitation could formerly close as retired while its own task call or manual Wake was unresolved.
correction: Under the existing project lease, both terminal outcomes validate task activity. The existing registration lock rechecks the exact record and assignment scope before a terminal action can change a delivery or ledger.
cases: Queued and ambiguously submitted manual Wake preserve OPEN and the original assignment on both terminal outcomes.
An active task call prevents both completion and retirement.
An exact SENT receipt without a complete response timer still prevents release.
After the exact response timer completes, retirement closes the original request and a repeat reads back the same closure.
An associated invitation with no execution grant or journal can still retire with an exact receipt-free STALE record and preserved assignment.
remaining: First qualify the installed v5 edit, verification, Git checkpoint and same-task self-Wake. Then verify serial ownership and safe yielding with two registered projects.
